product_family: Render is a cloud application-hosting (PaaS) platform: web services, static sites, private services, background workers, cron jobs, durable workflows, managed Postgres, and a Redis-compatible key-value store, spanning a free tier up through Team/Organization and Enterprise workspace tiers with tier-gated compliance documentation.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Validates an organization's security controls and their operational effectiveness via annual third-party audit. ... Pro plan and higher can access (requires NDA): SOC 2 Type 2 report

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: All workspaces can access: SOC 3 report

certifications.name: GDPR (posture / DPA)
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR-DPA: protects the personal data and privacy of EU citizens for transactions that occur within EU member states

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (incl. UK extension, Swiss-US DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: Certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework including the UK extension and Swiss-US DPF

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Render supports HIPAA-enabled workspaces for organizations that process and store US health data. ... Build and scale healthcare applications on a compliant platform.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: not mentioned on Render's security, trust, or certifications pages. Render is not a payments processor (billing is handled by a third-party payment processor), so PCI DSS scope would not apply to Render's own environment.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on render.com; only ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is claimed.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Render markets itself as infrastructure for deploying agents/AI workloads, but does not claim an AI-governance certification such as ISO 42001 or CSA STAR for AI on any of its security, trust, or certifications pages.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on render.com.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on render.com.

privacy.ai_training_note: Render is an infrastructure/PaaS provider (compute, storage, databases, workflows), not a model vendor or SaaS app that trains on user content. Its 'Agents'/'Render MCP' features are deploy targets for customers' own agent code, not a first-party AI product ingesting customer data for training. No page (security, trust, privacy, or certifications) references training AI/ML models on customer data.
privacy.data_region: Primary hosting via subprocessors AWS and GCP (United States); no explicit customer-selectable EU/other data-residency region was found in the captured pages. Render is certified under the EU-US DPF, UK extension, and Swiss-US DPF for cross-border transfer purposes.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Minimum AES-128 encryption for databases, backups, and secrets

security.name: DDoS protection
security.value: Built-in DDoS protection for every service, no extra configuration or add-ons

security.name: Private networking
security.value: Keeps internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet

security.name: TLS
security.value: Fully-managed, free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control and unique user identification for services/resources

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Built-in audit logging and monitoring for platform events

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Public bug bounty / VDP run via HackerOne; security contact security@render.com, abuse contact abuse@render.com

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Cloudflare, ClickHouse Inc. (all United States) listed as of the captured page

products.name: Render (core platform, all tiers)
products.data_scope: Customer application code, container images/build artifacts, environment variables and secrets, database contents (Render Postgres/Key Value), logs and metrics
products.notes: Base platform: web services, static sites, private services, background workers, cron jobs, workflows. Free tier available; compliance documents are still tier-gated even for paying customers below Organization tier.

products.name: Render Organization / Pro tier and above
products.data_scope: Same as core platform plus access to gated compliance evidence
products.notes: Only Organization-tier-and-above workspaces (with an NDA) can download the SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 certificate, and Render security policy; all workspaces (including free) get the SOC 3 report and GDPR DPA.

products.name: HIPAA on Render
products.data_scope: Protected health information (PHI) for customer healthcare applications
products.notes: Marketed feature for building HIPAA-compliant apps; full BAA terms and tier requirements are not confirmed beyond Render's own marketing claim.

compare.pricing_model: Usage/instance-based pricing with a free tier; paid Starter/Standard/Pro instance plans plus an Organization/Enterprise workspace tier that unlocks gated compliance documents

flags: Compliance documents (SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 certificate, security policy) are gated to Pro/Organization tier plus a signed NDA; free and lower-tier customers only get the SOC 3 report and the GDPR DPA.
'Render Compliance' (rendercompliance.com), a SOC 2 audit/CPA firm, is a separate, unrelated third-party company, not Render Services, Inc. None of its certifications apply to Render.com.

No evidence of an AI-governance certification (ISO 42001, CSA STAR AI) exists. Render is an infrastructure vendor rather than a first-party AI product; its 'Agents'/MCP hosting features are deploy targets rather than first-party AI data processing.
